subject: Television & Streaming
title: Disinformation in the Streaming Age
description: A quick, practical guide to Disinformation in the Streaming Age.

hook.text: YouTube's algorithm once recommended conspiracy videos to anyone who showed interest.

buildup.text: Streaming platforms optimized for engagement, not truth.

discovery.text: Documentaries like The Social Dilemma exposed how algorithms radicalize viewers by feeding them increasingly extreme.

twist.text: The platforms that replaced TV inherited its power to shape reality—but dropped editorial standards entirely.

climax.text: Streaming-age disinformation moves faster and reaches further than broadcast propaganda ever could.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't care what's true. It cares what you'll click.

quiz.question: Why are streaming platforms effective at spreading disinformation?
options: Algorithms optimize for engagement, not truth, promoting extreme content
